sources.author: Lustx
patch_list: Restores Pawxy's hidden video/media sniffer to the default tool menu. The toolbar builder excludes Tool$Action.SNIFFER from the default list; this patch removes that exclusion so the sniffer appears like any other tool.
Either removes the rate-us popup entirely, or rewrites its text. Rewrite mode changes the dialog title/body/buttons. Remove mode kills the trigger so the popup never appears.
Unlocks Pawxy premium features (VPN servers, removes paywall and upsell badges).
